title: Tier 2 Layer Sign-Off Verdict
description: Returned by the Claude Opus Phase B pass via --json-schema (structured_output in the final stream-json result event) or written to .agents/reviews/LAYER-N-verdict.json as the fallback. The human-readable audit lives in .agents/reviews/LAYER-N-signoff.md.

summary.description: At most 5 sentences for the human progress report.

spec_drift.description: Files whose implementation disagrees with SYSTEM_SPEC.md or a frozen contract.

rework_tasks.description: Task IDs of the new rework task files Opus wrote to .agents/tasks/ for this layer. Must be empty when verdict is SIGNED_OFF and non-empty when verdict is REWORK.
